Elara Chen: Hey everyone :wave: I’m Elara — joining as Backend ML Engineer (she/her) in SF. I like teal, terrible at keeping succulents alive, and I make a mean oat latte. Excited to jump into infra and pair on batching stuff!
Sam Pizza: welcome!! :tada: Lunch Friday?
Juno: hi Elara! can't wait to see your setup. also we have a plant swap in two weeks if you want a (possibly doomed) roommate for a cactus 🌵
Harper Lin: Welcome Elara — I work on infra. Ping me if you want a tour of the GPU pods or weird tracing dashboards :nerd_face:
Dev-Bot: Elara Chen was added to #new-hires and granted access to onboarding docs.
Keiko: quick poll — tea or coffee? we need to know who to bribe for the morning standup ☕️
Elara Chen: tea 95% of the time, but will accept espresso in emergencies. also happy to try any office rituals.
Sam Pizza: tea squad! I'll bring a travel french press tomorrow.
Maya Chen: @Elara Chen welcome!! people ops scheduled a 2pm intro — check your calendar for the Zoom link.
Juno: also welcome kit includes a small plant — tell me your favorite pot color so I don't pick something tragic :wink:
Elara Chen: fav color = teal, but honestly I will love anything non-plastic. Thanks all, excited to meet y'all in person :smile:
Sam Pizza: :raised_hands: :party_parrot:
